newsitem.title: ESTONIA: MOST STOCKS FIRM, BOURSE SAILS OUT OF DOLDRUMS.
newsitem.headline: MOST STOCKS FIRM, BOURSE SAILS OUT OF DOLDRUMS.

text.p: * Total trade was 77.2. million kroons on Monday compared to
51.9 million kroons on Friday.
* Talse gained 1.55 percent to 267.02.
* Hoiupank was the most active stock with a total
trade of 20.8 million kroons to be 0.38 kroons stronger on
136.44 kroons.
* Hansapank saw 9.9 milliion kroons traded to be
3.25 kroons higher on 142.90.
* On the free market, Norma traded 3.9 million
kroons to be 1.8 kroons higher at 73.10 kroons.
(A complete report follows)
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
Shares on the Tallinn stock
exchange stayed active on Monday, picking up on last week's
rally to close higher amid good volume, dealers said.
The Talse index rose 1.55 percent to 267.02 with 70.1
million kroons traded on the main list.
"The activity is a flow on from last week's run and it
certainly has attracted more interest to the bourse," one dealer
said.
"The price movement should hold for the rest of the week
with most dealers still holding orders they have not yet
filled," he added.
Hoiupank saw 20.7 million kroons traded to firm
slightly to 136.44, up 0.38 kroons.
"The possibility of a merger remains one of the factors
affecting Hoiupank, but there is still no real substance to the
comments as yet," another dealer said.
Hoiupank said on Wednesday last week that it would consider
merging with another local bank.
Uhispank turned over 16 million kroons to be 0.55
kroons higher on 45.55 kroons.
Trade on the free market was 7.9 million kroons with Norma
the most active at 3.9 million kroons picking up 1.80
kroons to close on 73.10 kroons after it announced a five-month
profit of 52.3 million kroons.
-- David Mardiste, Tallinn newsroom, +372 620 9202/1,
reuters@reuters.ee
